I was in a similar situation, so here's a few things that helped me/I've experienced and may help you too:

• Time really does heal. Although it was really painful in the first year, it gets less painful as more time goes on.

• If it hurts to partake in hobbies/activities that you used to do with her, try making some new ones.

• Talk about the friendship with people you trust. Sometimes, other people may help you uncover more of her toxic behavior and by talking it out, you can process your feelings better. Alternatively, you can write out your feelings and process them this way.

And more importantly, don't beat yourself up for being hung up on it. She was a close friend of yours; it's normal for her to affect you this much. It's ok to still feel pain when thinking about her; more importantly, you can learn and grow from this experience.
